30. The carrier of oxygen in blood is
(A) fat (B) hormone (C) haemoglobin (D) carbohydrate

31. The number of pairs of autosomes in human is

32. The most effective colour of visible light spectrum for photosynthesis is
(A) red (B) blue (C) yellow (D) green

notes: Pen-marks: Q31 option (B) '23' circled (wrong — correct is D, '22'; 23 is total chromosome pairs including sex chromosomes, not autosome pairs), Q32 option (A) circled — per F3 rule, never treated as answer source. No mark on Q30.
